text:
Emma: hey team! tiny personal update — promoted to Staff PM this week 🎉 and also we found out the baby is a GIRL! 🩷 celebrating next Fri 3pm in the 6th-floor kitchen with cake + a low-key confetti gender pop. would love for folks to swing by. thinking taco truck vs pizza + salad for food. vote below or just RSVP. no pressure at all. link to registry: tinyurl.com/emmas-list
Alex: HUGE congrats Emma!! :tada: will bring napkins and moral support
Priya: this is amazing, double congrats!! sending flowers later 🌸
Sam: tacos all the way 🌮 (and congrats!!)
Jordan: pizza please — but will happily eat confetti if needed 😂 congrats Emma
Maya: count me in. I can bring sparkling water + disposable cups
Emma: thanks all!! @Maya you are a hero. Cake ordered for 20 but if more people RSVP will up it. time is 3–4pm, feel free to drop by anytime during that hour
CalendarBot: Event created — "Emma: promotion + baby reveal" on Jul 18 15:00, Guests: 18 (added by Emma)
Lina: do you want us to chip in for a gift or is the registry best?
Gabe: congrats!! also — recommend no confetti in keyboards please 😅
Emma: registry is easiest, but if people want to pool something let me know and I can share an organizer email. no confetti near keyboards promise!
Nora: adding to calendar. can we put a tiny sign by the 6th floor elevator? some people miss kitchen events
Rahul: happy to coordinate vendors — if tacos win I can reach out to TacoMundo (they do quick service), if pizza wins I can call Slice&More
Emma: vote poll: 
- :taco: Tacos — quick + handheld (Rahul recommends TacoMundo)
- :pizza: Pizza + salad
- :shrug: Other (bring your own)
(react with emoji to vote)
Sam: reacted :taco:
Priya: reacted :taco:
Alex: reacted :pizza:
Jordan: reacted :pizza:
Maya: reacted :shrug:
Rahul: reacted :taco:
Nora: reacted :taco:
Gabe: reacted :taco:
Emma: looks like tacos are winning — Rahul can you follow up with a quote? also if anyone is remote and wants a tiny care package I can send a link
Rahul: will ping vendor now and post quote here later today
Priya: i'll bring a little card and a scrapbook page for messages if anyone wants to add a note earlier
Alex: congrats again emma!! proud of you ❤️
Emma: thank you all — this team is the best. see you friday!
